announcements.title: Arduino Workshop
announcements.text: Join us at Bard Hall to learn about one of the most popular microcontrollers on the market. This workshop is designed for complete beginners. We have free food!

announcements.title: Pacific Fusion Info Session
announcements.text: We will have a pacific fusion event this week. Join us on *5/9 12pm* at _Philips 101._

announcements.title: Welcome to AutoSec!
announcements.text: AutoSec (Automatic Secretary) converts any messages in a selected Slack channel into listserv announcements. The listserv contains any images attached to announcements. Messages support *bold* and _italic_ text.
